Biomechanical Analysis to Probe Role of Bone Condition and Subject Weight in Stiffness Customization of Femoral Stem for Improved Periprosthetic Biomechanical Response.

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Direct Read now simulation_case
Subhomoy Chatterjee, Sandipan Roy, Santanu Majumder, Amit RoyChowdhury Journal of biomechanical engineering 2020-10-01 10.1115/1.4046973
单位: Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Howrah, West Bengal 711103, India; Materials Research Centre, Indian Institute of Sci
通讯: Amit RoyChowdhury @ Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibp [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接研究股骨柄的刚度定制以减少应力遮挡，并考虑了骨条件和体重因素，与您的研究方向高度相关。
边界: The paper does not report micromotion values with explicit contact/friction modeling at the bone-implant interface.
动机· 研究骨条件和体重对股骨柄刚度定制的影响以减少应力遮挡。
方法· 通过内部空心结构定制刚度，并模拟骨重塑评估骨密度变化。
结果· 最佳空心程度取决于骨质量和体重：正常体重下最大空心有效，超重则需根据骨质量调整。
验证· 有限元模拟结合骨重塑算法，比较应变分布和骨密度随时间变化。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the influence of bone condition and subject weight on femoral stem stiffness customization for reducing stress shielding.
Method· A finite element model with internal hollowness was used to customize stem stiffness, and bone remodeling was simulated to assess periprosthetic bone density changes.
Result· Optimal hollowness depends on bone quality and body weight; for normal weight, maximum hollowness works, but for heavier subjects, bone condition dictates appropriate design to avoid bone or implant failure.
Validation· The study used finite element simulations with a bone remodeling algorithm, comparing strain distributions and bone density over time against the natural femur.

动机· 研究新型立方八面体结构多孔钛合金的压缩性能与变形机制
方法· 通过激光粉末床熔融制备Ti-6Al-4V多孔结构并进行准静态压缩实验

Motivation· To investigate the compression properties and deformation mechanisms of a novel cuboctahedron cellular structure in Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by additive manufacturing.
Method· Ti-6Al-4V cellular solids with a new cuboctahedron structure were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion and subjected to quasi-static compression tests.
Result· The deformation modes and fracture mechanisms were identified, and the relationship between mechanical properties and relative density was established.
Validation· Experimental compression tests combined with SEM observation validated the deformation and fracture mechanisms.

Motivation· To investigate how porosity and bioglass type affect the micro-mechanical and bioactive properties of coated porous titanium substrates.
Method· Porous titanium substrates with varying porosity were fabricated and coated with different bioglasses, followed by micro-mechanical testing and bioactivity assessment.
Result· Bioglass coating enhanced mechanical properties and bioactivity, with the effect depending on substrate porosity.

结果· 孔隙率增加提高生物力学性能但降低抗弯强度，涂层则相反

Motivation· To fabricate porous titanium dental implants with controlled porosity and evaluate their mechanical and biological performance for improved osseointegration.
Method· Porous Ti-2.6Al-1.2V-0.42 specimens with porosities from 0% to 70% were prepared by 3D printing and coated with chitosan via electrochemical deposition; three-point bending and in vitro cell assays were conducted.
Result· Increasing porosity enhanced biomechanical properties but reduced flexural strength, while the chitosan coating decreased biomechanical properties but increased flexural resistance.
Validation· Mechanical testing using a universal testing machine and in vitro biological assays with MC3T3-E1 cells.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Skim only in_vitro Exp. validation
Ke Zhao Clinical Oral Implants Research 2020-10-01 10.1111/clr.17_13644
单位: Sun Yat‐sen University, Guangzhou, China
通讯: Ke Zhao @ Sun Yat‐sen University, Guangzhou, China
相关性: 该论文研究了多孔钛的孔径和孔隙率对细胞相容性的影响，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关，但缺乏LPBF制造和力学测试。
边界: This paper uses powder metallurgy instead of LPBF, and does not include mechanical testing (static or fatigue) or stress shielding analysis.
动机· 确定多孔钛植入物的最佳孔径和孔隙率以促进骨整合。
方法· 通过粉末冶金制备六组不同孔径和孔隙率的多孔钛样品，并进行细胞相容性测试。
结果· 孔隙率53.3%、孔径191.6 μm的多孔钛表现出最佳的成骨分化能力。
验证· 通过体外细胞实验（蛋白吸附、细胞增殖、分化标记物等）验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To identify the optimal pore size and porosity of porous titanium implants for enhanced osseointegration.
Method· Six groups of porous titanium samples with varying pore sizes and porosities were fabricated via powder metallurgy and evaluated through in vitro cytocompatibility assays.
Result· Porous titanium with 53.3% porosity and 191.6 μm pore size showed the highest osteogenic differentiation and calcification.
Validation· Validation was performed using in vitro biological tests including protein adsorption, cell attachment, proliferation, and osteogenic marker expression.

Motivation· To compare the effects of different titanium alloy compositions and pore sizes on the physicochemical and biological properties of porous scaffolds.
Method· Irregular porous Ti6Al4V and Ti2448 scaffolds with pore sizes of 800, 900, and 1000 μm were fabricated by electron beam melting and characterized for surface, mechanical, and biological properties.
Result· Larger pore size Ti2448 scaffolds showed enhanced cell adhesion, proliferation, and osteogenic differentiation, indicating superior biocompatibility.
Validation· Mechanical testing (elastic modulus, compressive strength) and in vitro cell assays (live/dead, CCK8, SEM, RT-PCR, ALP) were performed.

动机· 探究3D打印钛合金表面形貌对骨整合的影响。
方法· 通过LPBF打印不同粗糙度的钛合金样品，进行拉伸测试和细胞实验。

Motivation· To investigate the effect of 3D printed titanium surface topography on mechanical properties and osseointegration for foot and ankle implants.
Method· Titanium dog bones and discs with varying roughness (polished, blasted, as-built, sprouts, rough sprouts) were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion and subjected to tensile testing and in vitro cell assays.
Result· Printed roughness significantly reduced ductility and did not enhance cell proliferation or differentiation, suggesting no benefit for osseointegration.
Validation· Mechanical tensile testing and in vitro cell viability, ALP, qPCR, and SEM analysis.

方法· 采用贝叶斯优化框架，结合高斯过程代理模型处理离散铺层变量和制造约束。

Motivation· To efficiently optimize ply-drop designs in non-conventional composite laminates under discrete variables and manufacturing constraints.
Method· A Bayesian optimization framework with Gaussian process surrogate models is employed to handle discrete ply variables and manufacturing constraints.
Result· The method achieves superior structural performance while satisfying manufacturing constraints, with higher optimization efficiency than traditional approaches.
Validation· Numerical case studies demonstrate convergence and constraint satisfaction of the proposed method.

Zichang He, Zheng Zhang 2020-10-01 10.1109/epeps48591.2020.9231388
单位: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of California, Santa Barbara, CA
通讯: Zichang He @ Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of California, Santa Barbara, CA
相关性: 该论文提出的主动和秩自适应张量回归方法可解决高维不确定性量化中的采样效率问题，对生物力学代理模型中的高维参数空间探索具有参考价值。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, lacks constraint handling, and focuses on electronic circuits rather than biomechanics.
动机· 解决高维随机谱方法中的维度灾难和低秩张量方法中秩自动确定与采样效率问题。
方法· 提出基于ℓ2,p范数正则化的秩自适应张量回归和基于估计Voronoi图的主动采样方法。
结果· 在19维和57维电子电路问题上分别仅用90和290个样本即准确捕获高维不确定性。
验证· 通过两个高维电子电路数值基准验证方法的采样效率和精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the curse of dimensionality in stochastic spectral methods and address the challenges of automatic rank determination and sample selection in low-rank tensor-based uncertainty quantification.
Method· Proposes a tensor regression method with ℓ2,p-norm regularization for rank adaptation and an estimated Voronoi diagram for active sample selection.
Result· Demonstrates accurate high-dimensional uncertainty quantification on a 19-dim bandpass filter and a 57-dim CMOS ring oscillator using only 90 and 290 samples, respectively.
Validation· Validated on two high-dimensional electronic circuit benchmarks, showing significant sample efficiency.

Motivation· To compare the success rates of debridement, antibiotics, and implant retention (DAIR) with versus without exchange of modular components for first-time periprosthetic joint infection after primary total hip arthroplasty.
